entities.summary: Maria Roth-Bernasconi is a Swiss politician who had served in the legislature and been former co-president of the women's chapter of the Social Democratic Party of Switzerland. As an MP she criticized Micheline Calmy-Rey's wearing a white headscarf to meet the Iranian President.
